title: Plane Mirror
definition: A plane mirror is a flat, smooth reflective surface—typically formed by depositing a thin layer of silver or aluminium on one side of a glass plate—that reflects light according to the laws of reflection to form virtual, upright, and laterally inverted images.
importanceInUpsc: Essential microtopic under General Science (Physics - Optics) for UPSC Prelims testing foundational laws of reflection, image characteristics, magnification, and field of view, while serving as a baseline concept for advanced optical instruments and defence applications like periscopes.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Plane Mirror reflection and image formation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and technological applications in optical systems.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding lateral inversion and magnification.
prerequisites: Laws of reflection (Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection)
